table.retrieve:
SELECT
	issueheader.issueinvcode, 
	RecipientCode =issueheader.RecipientCode,
	RecipientName = 
		CASE issueheader.RecipientCode 
		WHEN 1 THEN
			(SELECT D.Name FROM Department D WHERE D.DeptCode = issueheader.DeptCode)
		WHEN 4 THEN
			(SELECT S.Name FROM Salesman S WHERE S.SalesManCode = issueheader.SManCode)
		ELSE
			(SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = issueheader.Acccode)
		END,
	issueheader.date,
	item.name,
	item.customicode,
	issuetype = ISNULL((select name from issuetype where issuetypecode = issueheader.issuetypecode), ''),
	issuedetail.qty,
	issuedetail.batch,
	issuedetail.expiry,
	itempacking.name,
	saleprice=issuedetail.price,
	amount=issuedetail.qty * issuedetail.price,
	referenceno = ISNULL((select name from issuetype where issuetypecode = issueheader.issuetypecode), '') + CASE issueheader.issuetypecode WHEN NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' END + dbo.issueheader.referenceno,
	referencedate = issueheader.referencedate,
	AvgPrice = issuedetail.AvgPrice
FROM 	 
	issueheader, issuedetail, item LEFT OUTER JOIN itempacking ON (item.packcode = itempacking.packcode)
WHERE  
	dbo.issueheader.date >= :ad_StartDate and
	dbo.issueheader.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
	issueheader.issueinvcode=issuedetail.issueinvcode and
	issuedetail.icode=item.icode
ORDER BY 
	issueheader.issueinvcode
